Base.Apple.pre_existing: no item Base.Apple in admin's inventory

Base.Steak.pre_existing: no item Base.Steak in admin's inventory
Base.Steak.rcon_additem: Item Base.Steak Added in admin's inventory.

Base.CannedCorn.pre_existing: no item Base.CannedCorn in admin's inventory
Base.CannedCorn.rcon_additem: Item Base.CannedCorn Added in admin's inventory.

Base.CannedBologneseOpen.pre_existing: no item Base.CannedBologneseOpen in admin's inventory

Base.BreadSlices.rcon_additem: Item Base.BreadSlices Added in admin's inventory.

Base.ConeIcecream.rcon_additem: Item Base.ConeIcecream Added in admin's inventory.
